spec: Design a 4-bit full adder. It adds two 4-bit unsigned numbers a and b plus a 1-bit carry-in cin, producing a 4-bit sum and a 1-bit carry-out.
header: module adder4 (input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, input cin, output [3:0] sum, output cout);

spec: Design an 8-bit adder. It adds two 8-bit unsigned numbers a and b and produces a 9-bit sum (the extra bit is the carry-out).
header: module adder8 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [8:0] sum);

spec: Design an 8-bit subtractor. It computes a minus b for two 8-bit unsigned numbers, producing an 8-bit difference and a 1-bit borrow flag (borrow is 1 when a is smaller than b).
header: module sub8 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [7:0] diff, output borrow);

spec: Design an 8-bit comparator. It compares two 8-bit unsigned numbers a and b and produces three mutually exclusive flags: eq (a equals b), lt (a is less than b) and gt (a is greater than b).
header: module cmp8 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output eq, output lt, output gt);

spec: Design an 8-bit 2-to-1 multiplexer. When sel is 0 it outputs a; when sel is 1 it outputs b.
header: module mux2 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input sel, output [7:0] out);

spec: Design an 8-bit 4-to-1 multiplexer. sel selects which of the four 8-bit inputs a, b, c, d is passed to out (0->a, 1->b, 2->c, 3->d).
header: module mux4 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [7:0] c, input [7:0] d, input [1:0] sel, output [7:0] out);

spec: Design an 8-to-3 priority encoder. It outputs the index of the highest-priority set bit (bit 7 has the highest priority, bit 0 the lowest). valid is 1 when at least one bit is set.
header: module prio_encoder (input [7:0] in, output reg [2:0] code, output valid);

spec: Design a 3-to-8 decoder with an active-high enable. When en is 1, out[in] is 1 and all other bits are 0. When en is 0, out is all zeros.
header: module decoder38 (input [2:0] in, input en, output [7:0] out);

spec: Design an 8-bit odd parity generator. parity is 1 when the number of 1 bits in data is odd.
header: module parity8 (input [7:0] data, output parity);

spec: Design a 4-bit ALU. op selects the operation: 0=add, 1=subtract, 2=bitwise and, 3=bitwise or, 4=bitwise xor, 5=set if a<b (1 else 0), 6=set if a==b (1 else 0), 7=bitwise not of a. All results are 4 bits.
header: module alu4 (input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, input [2:0] op, output reg [3:0] result);

spec: Design an 8-bit barrel shifter. It shifts data by amt positions: dir=0 shifts left (zeros fill the low bits), dir=1 shifts right (zeros fill the high bits).
header: module barrel8 (input [7:0] data, input [2:0] amt, input dir, output [7:0] out);

spec: Design a 4-bit binary-to-Gray code converter. Each Gray output bit is the XOR of the corresponding binary bit with the bit above it.
header: module gray_enc (input [3:0] bin, output [3:0] gray);

spec: Design a 4-bit Gray-to-binary converter. bin[3] equals gray[3], and each lower bit is the XOR of the corresponding gray bit with the converted bit above it.
header: module gray_dec (input [3:0] gray, output [3:0] bin);

spec: Design a single-digit BCD adder. It adds two BCD digits a and b plus carry-in cin, producing a BCD sum digit and carry-out. When the binary result exceeds 9, add the decimal correction (subtract 10 and set cout).
header: module bcd_add (input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, input cin, output [3:0] sum, output cout);

spec: Design a population counter. It counts the number of 1 bits in the 16-bit input data and outputs the count.
header: module popcount16 (input [15:0] data, output reg [4:0] count);

spec: Design a 3-to-7 thermometer encoder. The number of 1 bits in out equals the value of in (out is all zeros for in=0 and all ones for in=7).
header: module therm3 (input [2:0] in, output [6:0] out);

spec: Design an 8-bit two's complement negator. neg is the two's complement of a (equivalent to 0 minus a in 8-bit arithmetic).
header: module neg8 (input [7:0] a, output [7:0] neg);

spec: Design a 4-bit unsigned multiplier. It multiplies two 4-bit numbers a and b and produces the 8-bit product.
header: module mul4 (input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, output [7:0] prod);

spec: Design an 8-bit absolute difference circuit. diff is the absolute value of a minus b.
header: module absdiff8 (input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [7:0] diff);

spec: Design a 3-input majority voter. y is 1 when at least two of the three inputs a, b, c are 1.
header: module maj3 (input a, input b, input c, output y);

spec: Design an 8-bit up counter with synchronous reset and enable. On each clock edge, if rst is 1 the count goes to 0; otherwise if en is 1 the count increments by 1 (wrapping from 255 back to 0).
header: module counter8 (input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [7:0] count);

spec: Design an 8-bit counter with synchronous reset and parallel load. On each clock edge: if rst is 1 the count goes to 0; else if load is 1 the count becomes data; otherwise it increments by 1.
header: module load_counter8 (input clk, input rst, input load, input [7:0] data, output reg [7:0] count);

spec: Design a BCD decade counter. On each clock edge with en=1, count increments and wraps from 9 back to 0. tc (terminal count) is 1 whenever count equals 9.
header: module bcd_counter (input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [3:0] count, output tc);

spec: Design an 8-bit up/down counter with synchronous reset and enable. When en is 1, count increments if up is 1 and decrements if up is 0 (wrapping in both directions).
header: module updown8 (input clk, input rst, input en, input up, output reg [7:0] count);

spec: Design a 4-bit LFSR (linear feedback shift register) with feedback polynomial x^4+x^3+1. On reset the state seeds to 1. On each enabled clock edge the state shifts left and the new low bit is the XOR of the two highest bits.
header: module lfsr4 (input clk, input rst, input en, output [3:0] state);

spec: Design an 8-bit bidirectional shift register. On each enabled clock edge: if dir is 1, shift right with sin entering the most significant bit; if dir is 0, shift left with sin entering the least significant bit.
header: module shifter8 (input clk, input rst, input en, input dir, input sin, output reg [7:0] q);

spec: Design an 8-bit parallel-in serial-out shift register. When load is 1 the register captures data; otherwise when shift_en is 1 it shifts left one bit (zero fills the low bit). sout is always the current most significant bit.
header: module piso8 (input clk, input rst, input load, input [7:0] data, input shift_en, output sout);

spec: Design an 8-bit serial-in parallel-out shift register. On each enabled clock edge the register shifts left and captures sin into the least significant bit. q is the current register contents.
header: module sipo8 (input clk, input rst, input en, input sin, output reg [7:0] q);

spec: Design a 16-bit accumulator. On each enabled clock edge it adds the 8-bit data to the 16-bit acc register (so repeated additions do not overflow). Synchronous reset clears acc to 0.
header: module acc8 (input clk, input rst, input en, input [7:0] data, output reg [15:0] acc);

spec: Design a 16-word by 8-bit synchronous-write RAM. When we is 1, the data on wdata is written to mem[addr] at the clock edge. Reading is asynchronous: rdata always reflects mem[addr].
header: module ram16x8 (input clk, input we, input [3:0] addr, input [7:0] wdata, output [7:0] rdata);

spec: Design an 8-deep 8-bit FIFO. push writes din into the FIFO (ignored when full), pop removes the oldest entry (ignored when empty). dout always shows the oldest entry, full and empty are status flags. Synchronous reset clears all entries.
header: module fifo8x8 (input clk, input rst, input push, input pop, input [7:0] din, output [7:0] dout, output full, output empty);

spec: Design a divide-by-10 clock divider. clk_out is high for 5 clock cycles and low for 5 clock cycles (50 percent duty cycle). Synchronous reset restarts the count.
header: module clkdiv10 (input clk, input rst, output clk_out);

spec: Design a pulse stretcher. A 1-cycle pulse on the pulse input makes stretched stay high for 4 clock cycles (the cycle the pulse arrives plus the following 3 cycles). A new pulse while stretched is high restarts the count.
header: module pulse_stretch4 (input clk, input rst, input pulse, output stretched);

spec: Design an 8-bit counter with a programmable terminal count. When count reaches the max input, the next enabled clock edge wraps it to 0. tc is 1 whenever count equals max.
header: module counter8_tc (input clk, input rst, input en, input [7:0] max, output reg [7:0] count, output tc);

spec: Design a 4-bit ring counter. It starts as 0001 after reset and on each enabled clock edge the single 1 bit rotates to the next position (0001 -> 1000 -> 0100 -> 0010 -> 0001).
header: module ring4 (input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Design a 4-bit Johnson counter (twisted ring counter). Each clock edge shifts the register right and feeds the complement of the last bit back into the first bit, giving an 8-state cycle: 0000 -> 1000 -> 1100 -> 1110 -> 1111 -> 0111 -> 0011 -> 0001 -> 0000.
header: module johnson4 (input clk, input rst, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Design a 4-bit free-running counter with active-high ASYNCHRONOUS reset. The count increments on every clock edge and wraps at 15. A rising edge on rst clears the count immediately, without waiting for a clock edge.
header: module counter4_arst (input clk, input rst, output reg [3:0] count);

spec: Design a 4-bit counter with an overflow pulse. On the clock edge where count wraps from 15 back to 0, cout goes high for exactly one cycle. cout stays 0 when en is 0.
header: module counter4_cout (input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [3:0] count, output reg cout);

spec: Design a 4-bit saturating up/down counter. It counts up or down on enabled clock edges, but instead of wrapping it SATURATES: it stays at 15 when counting up past 15 and stays at 0 when counting down past 0.
header: module sat_counter4 (input clk, input rst, input en, input up, output reg [3:0] count);

spec: Design a rising-edge detector. pulse goes high for exactly one clock cycle after a 0-to-1 transition on sig.
header: module edge_detect (input clk, input rst, input sig, output reg pulse);

spec: Design a sequence detector for the pattern 1101 with OVERLAPPING matches. det pulses high for one cycle whenever the pattern completes. Overlapping: the input 1101101 contains the pattern twice (positions 1-4 and 4-7).
header: module seqdet1101 (input clk, input rst, input din, output reg det);

spec: Design a Moore state machine that detects the pattern 1011 with NON-OVERLAPPING matches. det pulses for exactly one cycle after the 4th bit of a match completes, and a new match can only start after that. Moore style: det depends only on the state.
header: module seqdet1011 (input clk, input rst, input din, output reg det);

spec: Design a two-way traffic light controller. lights is encoded as {ns_red, ns_yellow, ns_green, ew_red, ew_yellow, ew_green}. The cycle is: NS green for 4 cycles, NS yellow for 2, EW green for 4, EW yellow for 2, then repeat. The cross direction shows red whenever the other direction is green or yellow.
header: module traffic_light (input clk, input rst, output reg [5:0] lights);

spec: Design a vending machine controller. Items cost 5. The coin input accepts 3'b001 (value 1), 3'b010 (value 2) or 3'b100 (value 5). When the accumulated sum reaches 5, dispense pulses high for one cycle and change returns the excess. cancel returns the accumulated sum as change and resets it.
header: module vending (input clk, input rst, input [2:0] coin, input cancel, output reg dispense, output reg [2:0] change);

spec: Design a 4-bit Gray-code counter. The output gray counts in Gray code order (exactly one bit changes per step): 0, 1, 3, 2, 6, 7, 5, 4, 12, 13, 15, 14, 10, 11, 9, 8, then wraps.
header: module gray_counter4 (input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [3:0] gray);

spec: Design a 4-requestor round-robin arbiter. grant is a one-hot signal selecting one requesting bit. Priority rotates: each cycle the search starts from the position AFTER the last granted requestor, so no requestor starves. When no request is active, grant is 0 and priority is unchanged.
header: module arbiter_rr (input clk, input rst, input [3:0] req, output reg [3:0] grant);

spec: Design a simplified UART transmitter with 16 clock cycles per bit. Protocol: idle tx=1. On send, transmit one start bit (0) for 16 cycles, then 8 data bits LSB-first (16 cycles each), then one stop bit (1) for 16 cycles, then return to idle. busy is high during the whole frame; send is ignored while busy.
header: module uart_tx (input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg tx, output reg busy);

spec: Design a simplified UART receiver with 16x oversampling. After a falling edge on rx, verify the start bit at half-bit time (7 ticks) to reject glitches; then sample each data bit at its midpoint (8 ticks into each 16-cycle bit window), LSB first; finally check the stop bit. valid pulses for one cycle when a frame completes; frame_err flags a bad stop bit.
header: module uart_rx (input clk, input rst, input rx, output reg [7:0] data, output reg valid, output reg frame_err);

spec: Design a simplified SPI master (2 clock cycles per bit, MSB first, mode 0). Idle: cs=1, sck=0. On send: cs goes low, each bit is presented on mosi while sck is low and then sck pulses high for one cycle. After 8 bits cs returns high and busy deasserts.
header: module spi_master (input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg sck, output reg mosi, output reg cs, output reg busy);
module:
module spi_master (input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg sck, output reg mosi, output reg cs, output reg busy);
  reg active;
  reg [3:0] idx;
  reg sub;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin cs <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b0; mosi <= 1'b0; busy <= 1'b0; active <= 1'b0; idx <= 4'd0; sub <= 1'b0; end
    else if (!active) begin
      if (send) begin active <= 1'b1; busy <= 1'b1; cs <= 1'b0; idx <= 4'd0; sub <= 1'b0; mosi <= data[7]; end
      else begin cs <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b0; end
    end else begin
      if (sub == 1'b0) begin sub <= 1'b1; sck <= 1'b1; end
      else begin
        sub <= 1'b0; sck <= 1'b0;
        if (idx == 4'd7) begin active <= 1'b0; busy <= 1'b0; cs <= 1'b1; end
        else begin idx <= idx + 4'd1; mosi <= data[7 - (idx + 4'd1)]; end
      end
    end
  end
endmodule

spec: Design a digital combination lock. The unlock code is 1-2-3: the user enters digits one at a time with the enter input. Entering a wrong digit at any step pulses err for one cycle and resets the progress. After 1, 2, 3 are entered in order, unlocked goes high and stays high until reset. Enter is ignored while unlocked.
header: module digital_lock (input clk, input rst, input [3:0] digit, input enter, output reg unlocked, output reg err);
module:
module digital_lock (input clk, input rst, input [3:0] digit, input enter, output reg unlocked, output reg err);
  reg [1:0] matched;
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    err <= 1'b0;
    if (rst) begin matched <= 2'd0; unlocked <= 1'b0; end
    else if (enter) begin
      if (unlocked) begin end
      else case (matched)
        2'd0: if (digit == 4'd1) matched <= 2'd1; else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        2'd1: if (digit == 4'd2) matched <= 2'd2; else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        2'd2: if (digit == 4'd3) begin unlocked <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd3; end
              else begin err <= 1'b1; matched <= 2'd0; end
        default: ;
      endcase
    end
  end
endmodule

spec: Design a sequence detector for the pattern 1001 with OVERLAPPING matches. det pulses high for one cycle whenever the pattern completes (e.g. the input 1001001 contains the pattern twice).
header: module seqdet1001 (input clk, input rst, input din, output reg det);

spec: Design a parking garage occupancy counter. car_enter and car_exit are one-cycle pulses. count increments on enter and decrements on exit, SATURATING at 15 (full) and 0 (empty). If enter and exit pulse in the same cycle, count does not change.
header: module garage_counter (input clk, input rst, input car_enter, input car_exit, output reg [3:0] count, output full, output empty);

spec: Design a two-phase handshake controller. When req is asserted, ack goes high on the next clock edge and stays high until req is deasserted. When the handshake completes (req falls while ack is high), ack falls and pulse goes high for exactly one cycle marking the end of the transaction.
header: module handshake (input clk, input rst, input req, output reg ack, output reg pulse);

spec: Design a button debouncer. The stable output only follows btn after btn has held the same level for 4 consecutive clock cycles. Shorter pulses (glitches/bounces) are filtered out.
header: module debouncer4 (input clk, input rst, input btn, output reg stable);
